payload.criterion: acceptance.criterion is optional; brief/plan/verification acceptance roles do not list criterion in requires_payload
payload.verify_command: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; d=json.loads(Path('contract/project-design.json').read_text()); acc=next(r for r in d['records'] if r['name']=='acceptance'); assert 'criterion' in acc['optional_payload']; assert 'criterion' not in (set(acc['payload'])-set(acc['optional_payload'])); views=d['views'] if isinstance(d['views'], dict) else {v['id']: v for v in d['views']}; bad=[n for n,v in views.items() for r in v.get('roles',[]) if (r.get('occupant')=='acceptance' or r.get('name')=='acceptance') and 'criterion' in r.get('requires_payload',[])]; assert not bad, bad"
